title: InferenceRequest
description: Request body for submitting model inference. Contains input tensors and optionally specifies which outputs to return.

id.description: Optional request identifier. If provided, it is echoed back in the response for correlation.

parameters.description: Optional key/value parameters passed to the model.

inputs.description: Input tensors for the inference request.

outputs.description: Optional list of output tensors to return. If omitted, all outputs are returned.
